title: app-shell LocaleSwitcher still labels built-in languages from a hand list keyed by the retired zh / pt codes
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

Filing gate: out-of-scope finding of the contract review of PR #31043 (card #30911). The finding was reported in that PR's body and confirmed by the review on head `291ef83d8`. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
class: c · reach: every Console user who opens the language menu after PR #30902.

## What is wrong

PR #30902 renamed the built-in pack tags `zh` → `zh-Hans` and `pt` → `pt-BR`, added `zh-Hant`, and made `PLATFORM_LOCALES` (`@objectstack/spec/system`) the language table, each row with a native `label`. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/LocaleSwitcher.tsx` on `main` still keeps a hand list, `BUILT_IN_LABELS` (L44–55), keyed by the old ten codes `en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar`. `localeLabel()` looks the menu's code up there first, so `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant` and `pt-BR` now miss and fall through to `Intl.DisplayNames`. The menu then shows CLDR names that vary by runtime and ICU version instead of the table's labels. The docblock (L35–43) also still calls `pt-BR` "an app-shipped locale", which it no longer is.

## Wanted

1. Name built-in locales from `PLATFORM_LOCALES` rows (`tag` → `label`) instead of a second hand list. `Intl.DisplayNames` stays the fallback for app-shipped codes.
2. Update the docblock and any test pinning the old keys.

**Level:** code fix in `@object-ui/app-shell` (patch changeset owed), no spec change, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Related: PR #30902, #30511, card #30911, PR #31043.
